text: 创业板指、科创50指数均跌超3%，沪指跌1.2%，深成指跌2.39%，算力硬件、军工、消费电子、半导体等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近4600只
text_en: ChiNext Index and STAR 50 Index both fall over 3%, Shanghai Composite down 1.2%, Shenzhen Component down 2.39%, with computing power hardware, defense, consumer electronics, semiconductors among the biggest decliners; nearly 4,600 stocks fell across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
